notes.title: Twilight Melancholy
notes.content: [p]Hello Inspectors,[/p][p][/p][p]To conclude this series on new lighting environments, here is a quick preview of our twilight setting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/6155c2e329e4730ddc0f5302c67ed3a68756599e.png"][/img][/p][p]I only spent a few hours exploring this subconscious, but this mental journey exhausted me more than a real hike. I spent too much time working on this Inspector program, and the few days in the isolation room only increased my already existing tension.[/p][p]I should take a break, but the light of this sunset, with its purple reflections and surreal moon rising above the temple, captivates me.[/p][p]Despite the sound of the stream, I hear the murmur of an approaching sentinel. I cautiously move away, and once out of range, it forgets about me, leaving me free to lose myself in the landscape.[/p]

notes.title: Age of a New Dawn
notes.content: [p]Hello Inspectors,[/p][p]It seems you enjoyed the new lighting atmospheres we prepared for you. Today, we’re unveiling a new scene with a magnificent sunrise. We hope you like it as much as the previous one.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/c5d1fbc908710b2e814a7a76291c87257eeed08d.png"][/img][/p][p]These are my first steps in this universe. After a few days spent in the isolation chamber – a necessary precaution for any Inspector – I’m thrilled to be walking and breathing in the fresh air, even if it’s all just a dreamlike landscape created by my patient’s mind.[/p][p]My heart beats faster. This journey marks the beginning of a new era. If I can manage to wake this patient from their coma, the possibilities could be endless.[/p][p]The warm light of the dawn makes me forget the icy bite of the snow on my feet. I spot a tower on a hill ahead of me, surrounded by a luminous halo that urges me to explore it.[/p][p]I begin my ascent of the hill at a leisurely pace.[/p]

notes.title: Sweet Night
notes.content:
[p]Hello Inspectors,[/p][p][/p][p]While replaying [i]Firewatch[/i], I realized just how much changes in lighting shape the atmosphere and the scenery of a game. We’ve therefore decided to create different lighting moods, currently based on four modes: dawn, day, dusk, and night.[/p][p]It’s still a work in progress, but we wanted to share one of these atmospheres with you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/7d5f3d9a6fa42945e36d8e91de47bc54dc0c54dc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As you approach the summit, your breath nearly falters. Not from exhaustion — such a thing has no place here. The northern lights spill across the sky, and a violet moon rising on the horizon strikes a dazzling contrast against them.[/p][p]You step toward the warm glow of a campfire. In the frozen beauty of this night, each footfall crunches in the snow with a strangely satisfying sound — like a thousand tiny bubbles bursting beneath your feet.
Far below, the hum of a sentinel drifts upward, but at this distance its drone is almost soothing.[/p][p]For a moment, you forget why you are here. You could sit down, lose yourself in the spectacle for hours, and let reality fade away.[/p][p]You linger by the fire for long minutes, your eyes entranced by the shimmering curtain of auroras above, before continuing on your way.[/p]

notes.title: Spotlight on the Sentinels
notes.content: [p]Hello Inspectors,[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we're going to discover a little of The Inspector's lore with the sentinels. These organisms, which protect the subconscious of your patients, patrol (or wander?) the coma in search of intruders. Avoid the areas where they are located, because if they detect you, they will move towards you to dissuade you from further exploration.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/cc9265b44d995f531ed8ea00a20151c07e6a1f4d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Don't worry, however, if you lack reflexes or are allergic to nervous gameplay. The Inspector remains a dreamlike, relaxing adventure. There's no "Game Over" or adrenaline rush (as it was sometimes the case in Breaking Lockdown and Wild Dose).[/p][p]Take a deep breath, Inspectors, and enjoy your escapade into the subconscious![/p]

notes.title: The Inspector: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Hello Inspectors,

As many of you have asked to provide information about Steam Deck Compatibility, here's an official update.

In the current state, the Steam Deck version should be "playable". We are liaising with Steam Support to start the review process (Steam Deck review process is not enabled by default for all developers).

So as to get the "Steam Deck Verified" badge (and also "Full controller support"), we will have to develop a few "quality of life features", that we're targeting to have implemented prior to release.

As usual, we'll keep you posted. Until then, don't hesitate if you have any questions.

Thank you.
The InspecTeam

notes.title: The Inspector is recovering from Games Made in France!
notes.content:
Ciao everyone!

As someone noticed, the demo is not available for download anymore. 
Thank you for your precious feedback, we noticed as the build was really unstable and tended to crash 50% of the time so, instead of having players infuriate for that, we preferred to retire it, to focus on optimization. 

While working on fixing this problem, we are also working on some other stuff to deliver you a better experience in Q1 2023, tentative lunch date for "The Inspector".

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The PMF revamping (a special microphone that helps you to find the memories) is ongoing in will be released on playtest branch soon. It has a new tutorial making this instrument easier to use
[*] A complete saving system is under construction, to let you explore the game in more sessions!
[/list]


[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We are continuing to implement 4 major languages: English, French, Italian, Simplified Chinese
[*] Now you can skip the intro if you want
[/list]


[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevent use to properly using the stairs in the first beacon
[*] ENG trailer has some misspelled words
[*] Subtitles in the intro were not properly visible
[/list]

Thank you again to all the testers who played the demo!

Ciao,

E.

notes.title: The Inspector @Tiny Teams Festival 2022!
notes.content:
It's been a while, but don't worry, the development is proceeding well!

A lot of stuff going on in the past months, let's check together:

[h2]Tiny Teams[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/4ee9763f75a76a78a1827dbe915cc7a4b42dc16d.jpg[/img]
The Tiny Teams is a private event on Steam, curated by Yogcast. The payoff for this event is "Micro Studio, Massive Ideas", which perfectly fits with my game! I'm excited to be selected to participate in it!
The event starts on Monday and, for a week-long, the demo will be back, looking forward to your feedback.

[h2]Color of Indie[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/525561c6f5bf7edff62e28cd5f54198e371eaf19.png[/img]
Color of Indie is a new Tik Tok event where you can showcase your Indie game. Is curated by the creator of Lost Ember. It was a super fun experience, we reach the final stage, but we didn't get the podium!

[h2]LappiSoft[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/9457f0005baaa4f2bf4ba801538b86849d51cef0.png[/img]
I reached a point that the game lacks in some main points: save system, optimization, and marketing. I decided to ask for some help. Max, from LappiSoft, is the right person to assist me on this path. With his experience, we can reach a more polished final product, without losing the status of Indie Dev. 

[h2]Game Mechanics[/h2]
While the core game is the same, there are some new elements that slightly change the game experience.

[h3]Tutorial Screens[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/bd733b13b9d91132f86ace2255ffef957f80cf51.gif[/img]
A series of panels will guide you discovering the main aspects of the game. One of the main issues with the last demo was understanding how the world of "The Inspector" works. I think, thanks to these screens, I fix partially the problem.

[h3]Binocular[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/85bc95eb6a001e1b25242188aec5f899fba3a064.gif[/img]
The Inspector is a small exploration game. You need to find the memories to wake up your patients. But what happens if discovering memories is frustrating? I work on that and decided to insert special equipment, the binoculars, that helps you to recognize the memory's position.

[h3]Beacons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/6d276172787be414960ff5c717bb6fffe2f01a01.gif[/img]
If finding memories were too hard, finding and deactivating beacons was too easy! So I work also on that. Now, prior to shutdown a beacon, you need to answer a specific question. You can answer to this question only if you have found the related memories. This thing prevents players from shutdown all the beacons before finding memories.

That's all for the moment! Thank you for following my game.

E.

notes.title: The demo season is over!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354442/96ffd592d26a4be00832b990657cfeba85ea3c6e.gif[/img]
[h2]Thanks to everyone who has stopped on my page!
[/h2]
During this long week, I received tons of feedback and some of you have made some precious video footage, giving me hints to understand where the major issues with the game are.

Overall this Steam Next Fest was amazing! I'm impressed by the result! 

- [i]1062[/i] new wishlist (steam)

- [i]360[/i] unique users have played the demo 

- over 500 joined during stream!


[h3]The main problems that the community has found are:[/h3]

- [i]Pixel graphic[/i]. Someone loves it, others really hate it. (there is one guy that asked me if his graphic card is broken...). ACTION ---> pixel graphics should be an option.

- [i]Performance[/i]. If the game doesn't run on smooth 60 fps on a potato, people generally tend to think your product is crap. ACTION ---> I need to optimize as much as I can the game!

- [i]PMF[/i]. The last portion of the game, where you need to use the PMF, wants really clear. People struggled to understand how it work. ACTION ---> tutorial revamp

Starting from this moment, the Demo will return in a "hidden" state but, if you are interested in helping in testing, you can request access on Discord: http://discord.gg/RZEPW2x6jV 

Wish you the best!



E.
